data.description:
External PR https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/c11/pull/215 (author MdMxMyr, 2026-05-30, single commit) adds GitHub Copilot CLI as a built-in agent type. Operator has CLEARED IT TO MERGE (2026-06-12) pending deep review + rebase. OPERATOR FLAG: extra scrutiny on this one — external author; review every line as foreign code before merging.

State: CONFLICTING with main, and will conflict again after C11-136 (#212) lands since both touch the same agent-registry files. Same modernization constraint: conversation store is the resume path (0.44+); do not wire into deprecated AgentRestartRegistry. NOTE: this PR touches GhosttyTabs.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj AND ships Resources/bin/copilot (a session-resume wrapper) — review the wrapper against the CLAUDE.md 'unopinionated about the terminal' constraints (no persistent writes outside c11 runtime, PATH-scoped gating, fall-through behavior) and expect pbxproj diff bloat per the known xcodeproj-gem normalization pitfall (gate on xcodebuild -list + membership counts, not line-by-line diff).

Files: CLI/c11.swift, project.pbxproj, Resources/bin/copilot, AgentChip, AgentDetector, AgentSkillsView, DefaultAgentConfig, SkillInstaller, SurfaceMetadataStore, c11Tests/AgentDetectorTests + DefaultAgentConfigTests, skills/c11/references/api.md.

Acceptance: deep line-by-line review recorded (security-minded: it ships an executable wrapper); rebased onto main AFTER C11-136 merges, preserving contributor authorship; builds green; c11-logic green; wrapper validated against the Resources/bin/claude reference implementation; skills synced if touched; localization pass; merged; PR comment crediting the contributor.

Related: C11-136 (PR #212, same files, same delegator thread — merge order #212 first).
data.title: Land PR #215: GitHub Copilot CLI as built-in agent type (rebase + deep review + merge)

data.body:
DEEP REVIEW (pre-rebase, security-minded per operator flag) — PR #215 (GitHub Copilot CLI), commit 81123c0 by MdMxMyr <maxmeyer@live.nl>, May 29. 13 files, +253/-43.

SWIFT (clean, mirrors the grok/#212 pattern exactly): AgentType.githubCopilot='github-copilot' (factory 'copilot --allow-all --autopilot'), canonicalTerminalTypes, AgentChip icon + 'paperplane.fill' SF fallback, AgentDetector (comm 'copilot' + node-args '@github/copilot'/'/copilot'), default-agent CLI list, SkillInstaller .copilot target, AgentSkillsView opt-in. Ships c11Tests/AgentDetectorTests.swift (NEW, 56 lines — good coverage incl. node-wrapped + negative cases) + DefaultAgentConfigTests grok-style factory test.

WRAPPER AUDIT — Resources/bin/copilot (116 lines, executable session-resume wrapper). Audited against Resources/bin/codex (its stated model) + Resources/bin/claude + CLAUDE.md 'unopinionated about the terminal':
- PATH-scoped + gated: requires CMUX_SURFACE_ID set AND live socket (bounded 0.75s ping). Passes through otherwise. PASS.
- NO persistent writes outside c11 runtime: the ONLY write is 'c11 set-agent --type github-copilot' over c11's own socket. Does NOT touch ~/.copilot/, dotfiles, or tenant config. Explicitly declines session-id capture (copilot has no --session-id launch flag; documented). PASS — minimal capture, cleaner than claude's wrapper.
- Clean fall-through: find_real_copilot skips self_dir (no infinite self-exec), execs real binary unchanged on every pass-through path + at end; exit 127 if missing. PASS.
- Non-interactive pass-through: -p/--prompt/--acp/-h/--help/-V/--version/--connect exec real binary WITHOUT flipping terminal_type. Good hygiene. PASS.
- Background write + disown so startup latency unaffected and wrapper can't outlive exec. Kill switch CMUX_COPILOT_HOOKS_DISABLED=1. PASS.
- Uses CMUX_* env names — MATCHES sibling wrappers (claude/codex also CMUX_*; binary dual-reads). Keeping for sibling consistency; a C11_* sweep should convert all three together, not diverge one file.
VERDICT: wrapper is safe and idiomatic. No security concerns.

PBXPROJ: adds copilot to the 'Copy CLI' bundling phase (same as codex) + AgentDetectorTests.swift to test target(s). Will gate on xcodebuild -list + membership counts per known gem-normalization bloat, not line-by-line.

REBASE/MODERNIZE PLAN (after #212 merges): (1) re-apply onto post-#212 main — expect conflicts in AgentType enum, canonicalTerminalTypes, AgentChip (grok now adjacent), CLI list, AgentSkillsView, SkillInstaller, api.md/metadata.md. (2) Same modernization as grok: #215 adds NO conversation strategy — add GitHubCopilotStrategy to ConversationStrategyRegistry.v1 (fresh-launch-only; copilot has no --session-id so resume is fresh, /resume is in-session). (3) localize agentType.githubCopilot='GitHub Copilot' x6 locales. (4) verify bundled copilot keeps +x bit. (5) sync skills.

VALIDATION (tagged build pr-215-land, socket /tmp/c11-debug-pr-215-land.sock):
- Full Debug app build (c11 scheme): ** BUILD SUCCEEDED ** (cherry-pick + GitHubCopilotStrategy + pbxproj/xcstrings).
- c11-logic DefaultAgentConfigTests: 30 tests ** TEST SUCCEEDED ** incl. testFactoryGitHubCopilotCommandIncludesAllowAllAndAutopilot + testAgentTypeGitHubCopilotRawValueIsKebabCase.
- Live CLI plumbing on tagged instance:
  * 'default-agent set github-copilot' -> OK; get -> OK github-copilot.
  * valid-types list reads: claude-code, codex, grok, kimi, opencode, github-copilot, custom (confirms #212/grok is in the base and #215 stacks cleanly).
  * 'set-agent --type github-copilot' round-trips: terminal_type=github-copilot stored CANONICAL (proves SurfaceMetadataStore change).
- WRAPPER: Resources/bin/copilot is bundled into the built app at Contents/Resources/bin/copilot AND executable (rwxr-xr-x 4582 bytes) — proves the Copy CLI phase + pbxproj wiring, so the wrapper is PATH-active inside c11 terminals. Wrapper logic audited earlier (PASS: PATH-scoped, no persistent writes, clean fall-through, minimal capture).
- Chip: github-copilot resolves through AgentChipResolver to paperplane.fill SF-symbol fallback (no AgentIcons/github-copilot asset shipped, by design).
CAVEAT (explicit, no faked e2e): the copilot CLI binary is not installed on this machine, so no real Copilot agent was launched and live /resume not exercised. Validated c11-SIDE plumbing + bundled-wrapper-executable only.
NOTE: c11Tests host target still has the pre-existing local-only SurfaceActivityTests compile error (untouched) — ConversationStrategyTests (incl. new copilot tests) deferred to CI.
Landing PR opened: https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/c11/pull/243 (land/pr-215 -> main). Contributor authorship preserved on commit 1 (MdMxMyr); modernization in commit 2.

Landed PR #215 (GitHub Copilot CLI) via rebased PR #243 (merged 2026-06-13), after #242/grok. Contributor authorship preserved (commit 81123c0, MdMxMyr <maxmeyer@live.nl>); modernization in a separate follow-up commit. SECURITY: audited Resources/bin/copilot line-by-line (operator flag) — PASS (PATH-scoped, no persistent writes outside c11 runtime, clean fall-through, minimal capture). Added GitHubCopilotStrategy to the live conversation-store registry (PR had none; copilot has no --session-id so fresh-launch-only), 6-locale agentType.githubCopilot localization, pbxproj membership for wrapper + strategy + AgentDetectorTests. Validated: full app build green, c11-logic green (30 tests incl. both copilot tests), tagged build live socket round-trips (default-agent set/get github-copilot, set-agent canonical terminal_type), and the bundled copilot wrapper is present + executable in the app bundle. CI all-green (build job ran conversation strategy tests). Copilot CLI binary not installed → no faked full e2e, c11-side plumbing validated explicitly. Original #215 closed with thanks.
